finding_history.title: Owned scene8 process can exit during cmdline check
finding_history.detail: After cmdline.exists() succeeds, the expected normal exit can remove /proc/PID/cmdline before read_bytes(), raising FileNotFoundError outside the ProcessLookupError handler; zombie/exit cmdline can also be empty and fail identity assertion before pidfd readiness is checked. This falsely stops the preprocessing controller although the process has exited and the later empty-compute check could pass.
finding_history.change_requested: Handle exited process across the cmdline read and pidfd readiness check; retain identity guard for a live process and never kill the previous scene8 PID.

resolutions.finding: Owned scene8 process can exit during cmdline check
resolutions.detail: Latest source opens a pidfd first and treats ProcessLookupError as already exited. A readiness select(0) skips cmdline for an exited process. For a still-active process, FileNotFoundError and empty cmdline are treated as exit transition; non-empty cmdline must match both owned job identifiers. The same pidfd then must signal exit within30seconds and is always closed. Final empty-compute gate still precedes model launch. This covers both reviewed normal-exit races without killing any PID.
resolutions.review_scope: Only read latest local source for this fix; did not execute controller or perform GPU operations.
